notes.title: Quality of Life Changes
notes.notes:
It's been about 3 weeks since I released ChatBBT and I've been watching some of the feedback in the reviews, good and bad. This patch aims to address some of the key issues I've seen people have:



Removed flashing lights
Before releasing the game I knew that the flashing lights would be a concern. For this reason, I put warnings both in game and in the store. Despite this effort, the majority of negative reviews are complaints with the flashing lights. I feel this is likely a failure on my part to understand that, with or without a warning, there's just a point where it's too much for the average user checking out a free game. That being said, I've removed the most egregious of the flashing lights.



Removed misinterpreted sections
I had a couple reviews commenting on some of BinderClippy's more dubious character traits. I won't address these reviews directly, because I think that they're both inaccurate and deface both the game and myself, but I can't help but feel some of the misinterpretation is caused by a failure in my abilities to articulate the narrative on a portion of steam's demographic. To remedy this, I've gone and removed what I see to be the culpable portions of the game.
